SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a festival? (1 mark)
   A. A big celebration
   B. A quiet day
   C. A kind of house
   D. A river

2. Which houses in Lamu were built with coral stone? (1 mark)
   A. Tents
   B. Boats
   C. Round grass houses
   D. Old town houses

3. Which is a ceremony? (1 mark)
   A. A road
   B. A rainy day
   C. A wedding
   D. A market

4. Who can tell you about the history of your school? (1 mark)
   A. A random person
   B. A shop
   C. A stranger who has never visited
   D. The headteacher or teachers who have been there long

5. When giving peer feedback, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Say nothing
   B. Say something you like and something to improve, politely
   C. Say only bad things
   D. Laugh

6. Which activity earns money from visitors to game parks and beaches? (1 mark)
   A. Quarrying
   B. Fishing
   C. Mining
   D. Tourism

7. What is an economic activity? (1 mark)
   A. Work done to earn income or make goods and services
   B. A song
   C. A holiday
   D. A game after school

8. Which of these is a natural resource? (1 mark)
   A. Water in a river
   B. A school building
   C. A tractor
   D. A road

9. What is an industry? (1 mark)
   A. A school subject
   B. A type of weather
   C. A place where raw materials are made into goods or a service is given at large scale
   D. A kind of farm animal

10. Which industry uses milk as raw material? (1 mark)
   A. A sugar mill
   B. A shoe workshop
   C. A cement plant
   D. A dairy

11. Which town is Kenya's main port and a busy industrial town? (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kericho
   C. Kitui
   D. Nyeri

12. What is an enterprise? (1 mark)
   A. A weather chart
   B. A school rule
   C. A game
   D. A business activity to make goods or provide services

13. Wanjiru sold 10 tomatoes but recorded only 8. What should she do? (1 mark)
   A. Hide the money
   B. Keep quiet
   C. Blame a friend
   D. Correct the record and tell the treasurer

14. What is a budget? (1 mark)
   A. A plan of how much money you expect to spend and earn
   B. A type of tool
   C. A crop
   D. A game

15. What is a role model? (1 mark)
   A. A machine
   B. A person who breaks rules
   C. A kind of book
   D. A person whose good behaviour others admire and copy

16. Which action shows respect? (1 mark)
   A. Breaking desks
   B. Insulting classmates
   C. Ignoring teachers
   D. Greeting teachers politely

17. Which behaviour shows patriotism? (1 mark)
   A. Damaging public property
   B. Standing respectfully during the national anthem
   C. Laughing during the anthem
   D. Ignoring the flag

18. When talking about a conflict, which kind of sentence is best? (1 mark)
   A. I will hit you
   B. You are stupid
   C. Everyone hates you
   D. I felt hurt when...

19. Which is a peace message? (1 mark)
   A. Get back at them
   B. Talk, do not fight
   C. Shout louder
   D. Fight for it

20. What is a peace garden? (1 mark)
   A. A garden where pupils can sit and be calm
   B. A place for fighting
   C. A car park
   D. A market

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain why children must not be forced to do hard work. (3 marks)

22. Write a peace message and explain how it can help other pupils. (4 marks)

23. Write a short motto and explain what it asks pupils to do. (3 marks)

24. Explain why it is important to keep records of income and costs. (3 marks)

25. Explain the difference between a right and a duty and give one example of each in school. (4 marks)

26. Explain what an industry is. (2 marks)

27. Describe what you should do if you are being bullied. (3 marks)

28. Describe how you would make a poster on an economic activity in your county. (4 marks)

29. List four factors a company thinks about before building a factory. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A big celebration
   Festivals are big celebrations with songs and dances.

2. D — Old town houses
   Old Lamu houses used coral stone.

3. C — A wedding
   A wedding is a special event with customs.

4. D — The headteacher or teachers who have been there long
   Reliable people and records give true information.

5. B — Say something you like and something to improve, politely
   Kind, helpful feedback improves work.

6. D — Tourism
   Tourism serves visitors.

7. A — Work done to earn income or make goods and services
   Economic activities bring in income.

8. A — Water in a river
   Water in a river is from nature.

9. C — A place where raw materials are made into goods or a service is given at large scale
   Industries change raw materials into products or provide services.

10. D — A dairy
   Dairies process milk.

11. A — Mombasa
   Mombasa is Kenya's main port.

12. D — A business activity to make goods or provide services
   Enterprises earn money by making goods or services.

13. D — Correct the record and tell the treasurer
   Records must be honest and complete.

14. A — A plan of how much money you expect to spend and earn
   A budget plans money.

15. D — A person whose good behaviour others admire and copy
   Role models set good examples.

16. D — Greeting teachers politely
   Polite greetings show respect.

17. B — Standing respectfully during the national anthem
   Respecting national symbols shows love for the country.

18. D — I felt hurt when...
   'I' sentences share feelings without blaming.

19. B — Talk, do not fight
   Talking solves problems peacefully.

20. A — A garden where pupils can sit and be calm
   A peace garden is calm and beautiful.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: It harms their health, it stops them going to school, and it is child labour, which is against the law.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Talk, do not fight. It reminds pupils to solve problems with words, so there are fewer fights and everyone feels safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a clear message, 1 mark for correct language, 2 marks for the explanation.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Work hard, be kind. It asks pupils to study well and treat others with kindness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a short motto, 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for showing action.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: To know whether there is profit or loss, to show honesty, and to plan better next time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: A right is something you are allowed, such as learning in a safe place. A duty is something you must do, such as following the rules.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 mark for each example.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: An industry is a place or business where raw materials are made into goods, or where a service is given to many people.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for making goods, 1 mark for services or raw materials.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm and do not fight back, walk away to a safe place, and tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose one activity, draw a large picture showing people at work, write a title and two or three facts, and add one way of conserving the resource.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: Raw materials, market, transport, and water and power. Accept workers or land.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each factor.
